import { pick } from './kit/lang'

// Every word the band card, the pane, the note, the hub line and the command show, in English and Turkish
// (MODZ_LANG=tr). Read through `words()` while drawing: the language is known once the session starts.

const EN = {
  eyebrow: 'Handoff',
  title: 'Handoff',
  hint: 'A note for your next fresh chat',
  percent: (n: number) => `${n}%`,
  // The ask.
  askHeadline: (n: number) => `Context is ${n}% full`,
  askMeta: (threshold: number) => `ask at ${threshold}%`,
  askSub: 'Write a note of where you are, then go on in a fresh chat without losing the thread.',
  write: 'Write handoff',
  compact: 'Compact instead',
  notNow: 'Not now',
  context: 'Context',
  // While writing, and after.
  writingHeadline: 'Writing the handoff note…',
  savedHeadline: 'Handoff saved',
  savedSub: 'Start fresh with /clear: the next chat in this repo gets the note once.',
  showNote: 'Show note',
  gotIt: 'Got it',
  failedEyebrow: 'Error',
  failedHeadline: 'The note could not be written',
  tryAgain: 'Try again',
  // The pane.
  latest: 'Latest note',
  emptyLine: (threshold: number) => `No note yet. One is offered at ${threshold}% context, or run /handoff.`,
  writeNow: 'Write handoff now',
  injectOn: 'The next fresh chat here gets it once',
  injectOff: 'Not handed to the next chat',
  consumed: 'A later chat already took it in',
  stale: 'Older than a day: not handed on',
  turnOff: "Don't hand it on",
  turnOn: 'Hand it to the next chat',
  delete: 'Delete note',
  summarized: 'with summary',
  plain: 'no summary',
  ago: { now: 'just now', m: (n: number) => `${n} min ago`, h: (n: number) => `${n} h ago` },
  // The hub line.
  hubContext: (n: number) => `Context ${n}%`,
  hubReady: 'note ready',
  // The note itself.
  noteTitle: (stamp: string) => `Handoff · ${stamp}`,
  noteRepo: 'Repo',
  noteContext: (n: number) => `Context ${n}% full`,
  noteWhere: 'Where we are',
  noteGoal: 'Goal (latest prompts)',
  noteSteps: 'Open plan steps',
  noteFiles: 'Files touched',
  noteGit: 'Git status',
  noteError: 'Last error',
  noteMore: (n: number) => `…and ${n} more`,
  noteIntro: 'A handoff note from the previous conversation in this repo. Read it, then carry on from it.',
  // The command.
  commandHelp: 'Write a handoff note now (show: open the Handoff pane)',
  commandSaved: (path: string) => `handoff: saved ${path}. Start fresh with /clear; the next chat gets it once.`,
  commandFailed: (why: string) => `handoff: could not write the note (${why})`,
  commandShown: 'handoff: pane opened',
  noRoot: 'no project folder',
}

type Words = typeof EN

  askSub: 'Nerede olduğunu bir nota yaz, sonra ipi kaybetmeden temiz bir sohbette sürdür.',
  write: 'Devir notu yaz',
  compact: 'Sıkıştır',
  notNow: 'Şimdi değil',
  context: 'Bağlam',
  writingHeadline: 'Devir notu yazılıyor…',
  savedHeadline: 'Devir notu kaydedildi',
  savedSub: '/clear ile temiz başla: bu depodaki bir sonraki sohbet notu bir kez alır.',

  gotIt: 'Tamam',
  failedEyebrow: 'Hata',
  failedHeadline: 'Not yazılamadı',
  tryAgain: 'Tekrar dene',
  latest: 'Son not',

  writeNow: 'Şimdi devir notu yaz',
  injectOn: 'Buradaki bir sonraki temiz sohbet bir kez alır',
  injectOff: 'Bir sonraki sohbete verilmez',
  consumed: 'Sonraki bir sohbet zaten aldı',
  stale: 'Bir günden eski: aktarılmaz',
  turnOff: 'Aktarma',
  turnOn: 'Sonraki sohbete aktar',
  delete: 'Notu sil',
  summarized: 'özetli',
  plain: 'özetsiz',
  ago: { now: 'az önce', m: n => `${n} dk önce`, h: n => `${n} sa önce` },
  hubContext: n => `Bağlam %${n}`,
  hubReady: 'not hazır',
  noteTitle: stamp => `Devir · ${stamp}`,
  noteRepo: 'Depo',
  noteContext: n => `Bağlam %${n} dolu`,
  noteWhere: 'Neredeyiz',
  noteGoal: 'Hedef (son istekler)',
  noteSteps: 'Açık plan adımları',
  noteFiles: 'Dokunulan dosyalar',
  noteGit: 'Git durumu',
  noteError: 'Son hata',
  noteMore: n => `…ve ${n} tane daha`,
  noteIntro: 'Bu depodaki önceki sohbetten bir devir notu. Oku, sonra buradan devam et.',
  commandHelp: 'Şimdi bir devir notu yaz (show: Devir panelini aç)',
  commandSaved: path => `handoff: ${path} kaydedildi. /clear ile temiz başla; sonraki sohbet bir kez alır.`,
  commandFailed: why => `handoff: not yazılamadı (${why})`,
  commandShown: 'handoff: panel açıldı',
  noRoot: 'proje klasörü yok',
}

export const words = (): Words => pick({ en: EN, tr: TR })
